proof_summary: At \(n=473165\), the intermediate value \(a(n)+4=5292270077783\) is itself a Sierpiński number. A period-48 covering argument shows that for every exponent \(m>0\), one of \(3,5,7,17,97,257,673\) properly divides \(5292270077783\cdot2^m+1\), so this value lies strictly between the two proposed consecutive numbers.
